parameters.content:
## Full project visual demo
Import and click **Execute workflow**. Every media/provider step is simulated. No credentials, downloads, files, paid calls or uploads.

The default sample includes two successful jobs, one upload failure and one skipped DONE row. Change **Demo Settings** to test another failure or disable injection.

## MediaPipeline
Inspect each Code node output for timestamps, footage intervals, selected image paths and progressive caption events.

Demo image choices rotate deterministically; the Python engine uses random selection. Rendering here produces metadata, never an actual MP4.

## JobRunner and recovery
A rendered output is retained when upload fails. DONE follows a confirmed upload. Both success and failure return to the sequential loop.

The real Python backend handles filesystem errors, network retries, cancellation and cross-process ownership; this canvas demonstrates their flow.
